description: A script for testing the startup memory usage (RSS) of a project-related command using Node.js, platform detection, temporary filesystem setup, and resource usage measurement.

methods.name: formatFixGuidance
methods.description: Generates guidance message for fixing startup memory issues based on test case and details.

methods.name: formatFailure
methods.description: Formats failure messages with optional details and guidance.

methods.name: parseMaxRssMb
methods.description: Parses maximum RSS (resident set size) reported in stderr output.

methods.name: buildBenchEnv
methods.description: Builds a sanitized environment object for benchmarking, including temp directories and environment variables.

methods.name: runCase
methods.description: Runs a test case by spawning a new process, checks for RSS limits and errors, throws if limits exceeded.
